Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an Americans with disabilities act parking sticker authorizing the operation of wheeled all-terrain vehicles in recreation areas for persons with disabilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the operation of wheeled allterrain vehicles inrecreation areas for persons with disabilities; amending RCW 46.19.030and 46.63.020; adding a new section to chapter 46.09 RCW; prescribingpenalties; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department must issue, and design, an Americans withdisabilities act parking sticker for placement on a wheeled allterrainvehicle, authorizing access to recreation areas that are difficult toaccess by persons with disabilities, to an applicant that meets thefollowing requirements: (a) The applicant's disability must be determined by a personlisted under RCW 46.19.010(2) and recorded on a certification documentdesigned and administered by the department, establishing that theapplicant meets one of the following criteria: (i) Loss of one or both legs or feet; (ii) Inability to walk more than two hundred feet without having tostop and rest; p. 1 HB 2773 (iii) Inability to walk due to severe disability where a personcannot walk without the use of or assistance from a brace, crutches,walker, cane, prosthetic device, wheel chair, other assistive device,or another person; (iv) Lung disease from which the person's expiratory volume for onesecond is less than one liter when measured by spirometry or from whichthe person's arterial oxygen is less than 60 mm/hg of room air at rest; (v) Severely limited in ability to walk due to arthritic,neurological, or orthopedic condition; (vi) Uses portable oxygen; (vii) Cardiovascular disease from which the person's functionallimitations are classified as class III or IV under standards adoptedby the American heart association; (viii) Cardiovascular disease from which a marked limitation ofphysical activity causes fatigue, palpitation, dyspnea, or anginalpain; or (ix) Other disease or disorder including, but not limited to,severe arthritis or neurological orthopedic impairment that creates asevere mobility limitation; and (b) The wheeled allterrain vehicle meets all registrationrequirements under this chapter. (2)(a) The Americans with disabilities act parking sticker must beplaced on the rear of the wheeled allterrain vehicle. (b) The Americans with disabilities act parking sticker must berenewed every three years at the time of annual registration renewalfor the wheeled allterrain vehicle. If the person's disability istemporary, the sticker expires on the date submitted for recovery bythe physician as listed on the certification document. (c) The department may by rule establish a fee to cover the cost ofdesigning, producing, and administering the Americans with disabilitiesact parking sticker. (3) A person must carry either a Washington state driver's licenseor identicard when operating a wheeled allterrain vehicle with anAmericans with disabilities act parking sticker. (4) The privileges granted under this section may extend to onecompanion of the operator of a wheeled allterrain vehicle with anAmericans with disabilities act parking sticker serving as operator orpassenger of the vehicle if the vehicle is designed for passenger use. HB 2773 p. 2 (5) The submittal of fraudulent physician certification documentssubmitted to the department to obtain an Americans with disabilitiesact parking sticker is a gross misdemeanor. (6) The department may adopt rules to implement and administer thissection.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.19.030 and 2010 c 161 s 704 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall design special license plates for personswith disabilities, parking placards, and year tabs displaying theinternational symbol of access. (2) Special license plates for persons with disabilities must bedisplayed on the motor vehicle as standard issue license plates asdescribed in RCW 46.16A.200. (3) Parking placards must be displayed when the motor vehicle isparked by suspending it from the rearview mirror. In the absence of arearview mirror, the parking placard must be displayed on thedashboard. (4) Special year tabs for persons with disabilities must bedisplayed on license plates as defined by the department. (5)(a) Persons who have been issued special license plates forpersons with disabilities, parking placards, or special license plateswith a special year tab for persons with disabilities may park inplaces reserved for persons with physical disabilities. (b) Persons who possess an Americans with disabilities act parkingsticker as issued under section 1 of this act on his or her wheeledallterrain vehicle may park the wheeled allterrain vehicle in placesreserved for persons with physical disabilities.
